verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms first-party programmatic building blocks: release notes announce an official Rust SDK for BigQuery (still in Preview), and official Simba ODBC/JDBC drivers connect applications to BigQuery. The pack does not document the main GA client-library lineup, so official SDK coverage is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented GA client libraries for mainstream languages (e.g. Python, Java, Go, Node), SDK reference docs covering the Storage Write/Read APIs, a non-Preview status for the Rust SDK, and independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
